title: How Does a Blood Pressure Cuff Work?

input.text:
A blood pressure cuff is Harvey's tied band.

A blood pressure cuff squeezes your arm until the blood stops getting in, then lets go and listens for the moment it starts to flow again. It is William Harvey's tied band, the one he used to prove that your blood goes round.

How does a blood pressure cuff work?
